meta.reference: The Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues, ESA 1997, SP-1200, Hipparcos Main Catalogue I/239/hip_main (118218 records). Retrieved via VizieR 2026-11-17.
meta.frame: ICRS equatorial right ascension and declination in degrees at epoch J2000.0. Original J1991.25 coordinates advanced by 8.75 Julian years with catalogue proper motions on the unit sphere. For ten records without original astrometric solutions, the position is supplied by CDS SIMBAD at J2000.
meta.units: raDeg [0,360), decDeg [-90,+90]; Johnson apparent V and B−V in magnitudes; distanceLy in light-years. Values unavailable or insufficiently constrained are null.
meta.selection: All entries in the Hipparcos Main Catalogue with listed Johnson V <= 7.5. The magnitude-limited Hipparcos input is not every star in the sky. These catalogue directions are not apparent topocentric directions or real-time scintillation.
meta.distanceSelection: Prefer the selected 10 pc catalogue distances for shared HIP identifiers. Otherwise report 3261.563777 / Hipparcos parallax in mas only if positive with parallax-to-error >=5. Uncertainty grows rapidly for distant stars.
